evidence.quote: This paper presents a comprehensive empirical study focusing on crashes in publicly available Python ML notebooks.
We conduct an empirical study to analyze 92,542 crashes
in 64,031 publicly available Jupyter notebooks for ML in Python (referred to as ML notebooks throughout the paper).
